`final class GlyphLayout<F extends IFontFace>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.glyph` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [GlyphLayout.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/glyph/GlyphLayout.java)

A string laid out on one line, as the list of its glyph placements and its width.

## Description

[`GlyphTextRenderer.layout`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/#GlyphTextRenderer-method-layout) builds it: markup tags read, faces resolved, kerning and letter spacing applied.

|---|---|---|

| `double` | [getWidth](#GlyphLayout-method-getWidth)() | Returns the width of the line in design pixels, without the letter spacing after the last glyph. |
